scope: Directory traversal or local file inclusion that reads or includes files outside the intended path.
exclusions: Command execution after traversal belongs to rce_cmd_injection
Relative paths that stay inside the allowed root
Traversal in an AI agent tool call belongs to mcp_agentic_tool_abuse
required_evidence: Path-bearing parameter with traversal sequences in raw and decoded views
Target file or include context in server path handling
Response or error evidence when available
benign_counterexamples: Package request with dot segments normalized to an allowed root
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
